activity.notes: Mackenzie King's first, second and third premierships are historically discontinuous and are therefore stored as separate Activities. This first term ended on 28 June 1926 during the King–Byng crisis.

sources.title: National Program for the Grave Sites of Canadian Prime Ministers — William Lyon Mackenzie King
sources.citation_text: Parks Canada lists Mackenzie King's three prime-ministerial terms as 29 December 1921–28 June 1926, 25 September 1926–7 August 1930, and 23 October 1935–15 November 1948.
